item.coloph: khro bo rol pa'i stod smad cha lags (lag) dang bcas pa'i rgyud rim ni/ dang po ston pa gshen rab gyi bka'/ bar du stag la me 'bar gyi bka'/ tha ma lha bdag sngags gro'i bka'/ de nas stag gzig gi mkhan po g.yung drung ri pa la/ lo tsa g.yung drung blo gsal gyis/ stag gzig rgya skad du bsgyar/ gya (rgya) gar mkhas pa gsal grub dang / sum pa mu le dkar gsum dang / me nyag lce tsha mkhar bu dang / se bonaM sha ri dbu chen dang / ldem bon gyim tsha rma chung dang*/ zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen dang / mkhas pa'i rim par rgyud (brgyud) nas/ byad rgya bshigs pa'i man ngag go dar nub dus su gter du sbas so/ phyi rabs rdol ba'i smon lam btab/ dran pa nam mkhas gter sgo phye/ bod yul bstan pa dar rgyas shog (a+tha)sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ phri phral spar ya thum//
